followup.title: AP follow-up: multicurrency and FX accounting after USD release
followup.body:
Follow-up to #97, explicitly agreed by the user on 2026-10-25: “先完成当前 USD，多币种移到后续 issue” (finish the current USD system first; move multicurrency to a later issue).

The current AP release remains USD-only. Non-USD accounting/payment requests must stay visibly unsupported and fail closed. This issue tracks the broader currency work from the frozen #97 roadmap; it does not imply that multicurrency has been implemented or accepted.

Before implementation:
- Agree supported invoice and functional currencies and the rollout boundary. USD functional books with EUR/GBP vendor bills is a candidate, not an approved scope.
- Define exchange-rate source, effective date, precision, explicit reviewer authority, rounding, and rate provenance.
- Decide treatment of credits, partial settlements, reversals, realized/unrealized FX, revaluation, and period close.
- Confirm QuickBooks Online company multicurrency configuration and immutable currency/rate mapping.
- Select and authorize any non-USD payment rail. Increase sandbox remains the current USD execution rail.

Acceptance:
- Preserve original currency, functional-currency amounts, rate provenance, and balanced journals throughout invoice, credit, payment, recovery, and close flows.
- Add independent automated and integration coverage for supported currencies and fail-closed unsupported cases.
- Obtain actual sandbox round-trip evidence separately from simulated tests.
- Prepare examples and expected entries for a real AP/accounting practitioner; agent validation does not count as practitioner sign-off.

No production deployment, account configuration change, payment execution, or FX policy is authorized by creating this issue.

## Acceptance update — OCR packaging runtime gate PASS (2026-10-25)

Only the **OCR packaging runtime gate** is marked **PASS** by this update.

- Frozen source: `ed372a40570d714b5b893c6e4e86e25f2427bc80`. The original Dockerfile, lock file and smoke script were unchanged.
- Actual build succeeded (exit 0, 102.012 s) using existing Colima 0.10.3; Docker Client 29.9.2 connected to Server 29.5.2. Global Docker context was not switched.
- Actual image: `sha256:09c398f49cc16a60d0e7888b3939505d60f5482264ea0e86bb4374034352d9c7`, linux/arm64. Tesseract 5.5.2 and pinned English traineddata checks passed.
- The original bounded smoke ran on two controlled scans: Harbor Thread **123 nonempty words, 1584×1224**; Copper Valve **135 nonempty words, 1224×1584**. Single-page/zero-rotation/no-native-text, raster dimensions and word-box bounds passed.
- Smoke and container exited **0**, with no timeout or OOM; the combined invocation took 1.204 s. Network was disabled, root and three mounts were read-only, capabilities were dropped, no-new-privileges was set, and CPU/memory/PID/tmpfs limits were recorded. `accuracyEvaluated=false`; `providerCalls=0`.
- Initial container creation failed because the first host path was outside the existing VM share. That failure is preserved; the successful retry used a byte-identical snapshot in the existing shared home directory, without changing VM shares.

Master and a separate verification agent recomputed **90/90 evidence hashes**; the verifier also matched **12/12 source files** to the frozen commit, snapshot, mounted copy and current sources. The complete original 91-file evidence bundle is persisted in the local integration commit `9f87533` at `docs/ap-orchestration/evidence/A4-ocr-packaging-20261025/`, with review `docs/ap-orchestration/evidence/A4-ocr-packaging-review.md`. This integration commit has not yet been published to the remote. The evidence manifest SHA256 is `d709a5d4e0c585d384b7515a99832c7e767e553097a0f4dce9a1a42fddd624fc`.

**Scope boundary:** this smoke does not change the independent acceptance states for extraction accuracy, exact-word grounding, complete AP/`parseUpload` integration, multipage/rotation behavior, production readiness or the overall roadmap. Existing parser evaluations retain their own separate results. Generated PNG/TSV files were cleaned by the original script; their logged hashes cannot now be independently recomputed. Moving Debian tags/package versions also do not establish byte-identical future rebuilds. Issue #97 remains open.

Scope decision recorded on 2026-10-25: the user explicitly chose “先完成当前 USD，多币种移到后续 issue”. The current delivery scope is USD; broader currency and FX accounting is tracked in #104: https://github.com/srivatsav-kannan/autonomous-finance/issues/104.

The original frozen roadmap snapshot remains unchanged. Multicurrency is deferred by agreement, not marked implemented. Current USD tax/accounting/payment engineering and verification continue. UI acceptance targets laptop/desktop web per the user's latest instruction; public website hosting remains a later consideration.

This scope update does not close #97 or satisfy the outstanding actual operator, QBO accounting-transaction, Increase sandbox execution, or real AP/accounting practitioner acceptance gates.
